thread:
nina: Heads-up: kicking off staggered rollout for v1.23.1. Plan = US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 01:30-03:30 UTC. Posting short checklist and traffic plan here.

deploy-bot: [info] initiating us canary at 01:35 UTC. slice=us-west-2, instances=10, traffic=1%. rollout_id=rl-2026-3998

omar: Quick capacity check: can we sustain 2x burst for US if we see retry storms? Current warm pool reported by infra: us=16 GPUs idle, eu=6 GPUs idle, apac=0 (will pre-warm at 02:10 UTC).

jen: Warm pools confirmed in US and EU. EU kernel cache still populating (cache hit rate ~52%). We'll top up EU pool to 10 GPUs manually if cache miss >30% during ramp.

kevin: Proposing rollback rules: immediate rollback if 5xx rate > 1% absolute OR p99 latency > 600ms for 3m. Soft hold (manual) if error-rate > 0.6% for two consecutive 5m windows. Also pin EU to stable v1.22.11 on rollback.

nina: +1 on those. Add model-quality guard: BLEU-like eval fail rate > 4% on smoke promptset -> abort. Also note release notes link: https://internal/release-notes/1.23.1 (contains tokenizer changes and kernel patches).

ops-bot: CHG: CHG-2026-189 approved. Oncall: omar. Reminder: notify customers in `status` if we escalate to rollback.

deploy-bot: us ramp to 5% at 01:42 UTC. current us traffic=5.0%. smoke tests: token sampling ok. logs: no OOMs.

omar: Monitoring metrics: us p50 39ms, p95 115ms, p99 240ms. error_rate=0.12%. We are green.

jen: EU pre-warm started at 01:50 UTC. ETA to ready ~12m. APAC pre-warm scheduled after EU pass.

nina: Note: we'll insert a manual go/no-go before APAC. If EU shows any kernel-cache thrash or tokenizer warnings, we stop.

deploy-bot: EU canary start at 02:05 UTC: slice=eu-west-1, instances=8, traffic=1%.

jen: EU smoke quick read -> small tokenizer warning `warning: token mismatch at byte 0x1f` in 4/300 requests. Not huge but flagged. Kernel cache hit rate now 68%.

kevin: That warning rate ~1.3% of requests. If it stays <=2% and theres no latency spike, proceed. If it climbs >3% abort and pin.

omar: Telemetry snapshot (Grafana):
```
region | p50 | p95 | error_rate
US     | 40ms| 120ms| 0.11%
EU     | 60ms| 180ms| 0.28%
```
All within runbook thresholds.

deploy-bot: EU ramp to 10% started at 02:18 UTC. Pausing at manual holdpoint before APAC.

nina: Manual holdpoint: please post a 10m stability check and the golden-prompt eval before APAC.

jen: Golden-prompt eval running against 250 samples (EU). ETA 6m. Preliminary: failure=2.0%, quality delta +0.9%.

kevin: I'll be watching p99 and 5xx spikes. If p99 > 500ms or 5xx > 1% -> trigger rollback.

omar: After 8m EU p99 stable ~220ms, 5xx ~0.15%. Golden eval final -> failure 1.6% (ok). Kernel warnings down to 2 instances in last 10m.

nina: Given that, I authorize APAC pre-warm at 02:40 UTC and staged APAC canary at 02:50 UTC. Keep APAC capped at 5% until 30m stable.

deploy-bot: APAC pre-warm initiated. apac warm pool=6 GPUs pending; will report ready.

ops-bot: Reminder: customer-facing notice draft posted in #status-drafts. If any rollback, ops will send the note with rollback tag.

jen: FYI manual rollback command (ops runbook):
```
# rollback command
deploy-bot rollback --region eu --version v1.22.11 --reason "automated-trigger-or-manual"
```
Also pinned version set in config: `service.rollout.pins.eu = v1.22.11`

kevin: thumbs up. After-rollout checks: compare token-cost delta and kernel error logs for 2h post-deploy.

nina: Final: proceed to APAC canary at 02:50 UTC. I'll stay on this thread until 03:30 UTC. Thanks team.

deploy-bot: APAC canary started at 02:50 UTC; traffic=1%, instances=6.

last: nina: APAC initial metrics look ok at 03:05 UTC. Holding until full ramp schedule. Will post final completion or rollback if needed.
